arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

# Test bump_major
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5)
result = v.bump_major()
print('bump_major:')
print(f'  Original: {v}')
print(f'  Result: {result}')
assert result.major == 4 and result.minor == 0 and result.patch == 0
assert v.major == 3 and v.minor == 4 and v.patch == 5  # original unchanged

# Test bump_minor
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5)
result = v.bump_minor()
print('bump_minor:')
print(f'  Original: {v}')
print(f'  Result: {result}')
assert result.major == 3 and result.minor == 5 and result.patch == 0
assert v.major == 3 and v.minor == 4 and v.patch == 5  # original unchanged

# Test bump_patch
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5)
result = v.bump_patch()
print('bump_patch:')
print(f'  Original: {v}')
print(f'  Result: {result}')
assert result.major == 3 and result.minor == 4 and result.patch == 6
assert v.major == 3 and v.minor == 4 and v.patch == 5  # original unchanged

# Test bump_prerelease with existing prerelease
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5, 'rc.1')
result = v.bump_prerelease()
print('bump_prerelease (with prerelease):')
print(f'  Original: {v}')
print(f'  Result: {result}')
assert result.prerelease == 'rc.2'
assert v.prerelease == 'rc.1'  # original unchanged

# Test bump_prerelease without prerelease
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5)
result = v.bump_prerelease()
print('bump_prerelease (no prerelease):')
print(f'  Original: {v}')
print(f'  Result: {result}')
assert result.prerelease == 'rc.1'

# Test bump_build with existing build
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5, 'rc.1', 'build.9')
result = v.bump_build()
print('bump_build (with build):')
print(f'  Original: {v}')
print(f'  Result: {result}')
assert result.build == 'build.10'
assert v.build == 'build.9'  # original unchanged

# Test bump_build without build
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5, 'rc.1')
result = v.bump_build()
print('bump_build (no build):')
print(f'  Original: {v}')
print(f'  Result: {result}')
assert result.build == 'build.1'

print('\\nAll tests passed!')
"
